reviews.t: It works best in a double cleanse
reviews.x: With just a tiny bead of product on wet skin, this lathers up into a wonderful, dense foam. It’s not exfoliating, but it does break down the oils on your face extremely thoroughly—it’s best for washing off an oil-based cleanser. BUT you absolutely have to re-moisturize once you rinse this off. It strips away all oils, both natural skin oils and any excess oils, and you need to follow it up with toner or face cream or your skin will become flakey or over-compensate with excess oils.

reviews.t: BEST cleanser, I don't think I'll ever go back to a different one
reviews.x: This cleanser is life-changing. It foams a LOT, so you only need a tiny pea-size drop of it. The foam feels heavenly against skin and doesn't feel like it's too "harsh". I used it on my face and shoulders every time I get in the shower and after a few weeks, I've noticed I have a lot fewer breakouts (and I've struggled with adult acne for years). The packaging is also a sturdy squeeze tube so it's great to travel with.

I have been using honey Jarrett clean whip for 2 years. I love it but it’s $30 a bottle and takes forever to ship I compared the ingredients and this stuff is almost exactly the same. I’m on my second bottle. I love it plus the cost! I get 2 bottles for the cost of the one I was getting. I’m combination skin. Most stuff breaks me out but this left me clean and moisturized definitely purchasing again.

My go to cleansers! Makes skin feel squeaky clean but not to the point of feeling dry and crusty. I hate oily cleansers and the type that makes my face feel oily as I tend to break out more with those. This helps keep my face clean and clear. Be careful of getting them in your eyes though...

This cleanser is very good to remove oil from your face and it can make your face very dry,just a little can make a lot foam, but i prefer it not make my face so dry,after use i have to put cream on my face, so i think i would like to use some cleanser not make face so dry.
The soap itself is very thick but once you start rubbing it onto your face it lathers very well and rinses off well leaving your skin feeling very clean.  Reduced acne break outs very quickly.
This has been my go to foam cleaner for almost 6 years now. I have really dry sensitive skin and this product does not leave my skin dry and tight like many other cleansers tend to do.
In my experience, foam cleansers are generally going to be a bit drying, so be sure to use a moisturizer. I like this product, a little goes a long way, and it doesn't break me out.
